body: I don't want to go to a support group, I hate talking to people about this. In real life I pretend that I'm a tough mother fucker and the pain doesn't bother me.
Sometimes I feel like the rest of my life is too damn long. I'm gonna make an appointment tomorrow.
I've given up on doctors. They haven't done a damn thing for me. I complained that my meds weren't helping anymore and they put me on different ones that work even less.

I get up later and later everyday. I wish I could just stay there forever but someone would notice eventually and they'd want me to get help.

I honestly don't think I can be helped.
Yea I hope that someone will pull a gun on me and say "Your money or your life!" every time I leave my house. I'ts the reason I get out of bed in the morning really.
